summary: Independent editorial review found no blocking factual or depth defect in the approved article. The mathematical scope, artwork-versus-implementation distinction and perceptual uncertainty are appropriately bounded. Visual sample coverage and source privacy remain qualified by the separate private operator receipt.
findings: The article treats the work as audiovisual art and separates visible sampled formations from creator assertions about agent count, production method, soundtrack and simulation code.
The reviewed Bolduc v07 manuscript supports a finite prescribed-history endpoint characterization, not an unrestricted online distributed convergence or physical rendezvous theorem.
The distinct Blondin-Hale and Naderi-Blondin-Roy papers, oscillator model and perceptual studies are not presented as validation of this film or its audience response.
The proposed state, render and viewer experiments are identifiable as future tests; Tony’s personal response and private media are absent from the public article.
A source-map cue used circle as a verb for the sampled 18:20 formation. It was narrowed to surround to describe a still rather than imply observed motion; authored article bytes did not change.
Review did not independently inspect the private frames, soundtrack, continuous motion, hosted layout or every creator-linked deposit; those remain limits of this acceptance.
